ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
103
STUDY 087
Square-Neck Brown Top & Plaid Mini
Rights check
Source: 24975.jpg
Soft, polished, earthy
WORKING NOTES
- The square neckline and tartan skirt are the key
silhouette.
- Describe the rosette pendant to keep the detail
consistent.
Try this: Describe the rosette pendant precisely.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight dark hair pulled back at the
crown stands with her arms folded
against a pale gray backdrop. She
wears a brown fitted long-sleeve top with
a square neckline and a draped front,
paired with a green and cream tartan
mini skirt with a cream lace-trimmed
underlayer. A pearl necklace with a
rosette pendant sits at her throat. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of chocolate, forest
green, and cream. Soft and polished, in
the style of a fall fashion lookbook.
